title: Elegiac
summary: ELE'GIAC, adjective [Low Latin elegiacus. See Elegy.] Belonging to elegy; plaintive; expressing sorrow or lamentation; as an elegiac lay; elegiac strains. 1. Used in elegies. Pentameter verse is elegi
